# known_compounds.txt -- Project 1 (Word Segmentation & POS Tagging) fixture.
#
# One multi-syllable Vietnamese compound WORD per line, syllables separated
# by a single space exactly as they appear in running text. A correct
# segmenter must emit each of these as ONE token (interfaces.linguistics
# .Token.form spans all its syllables), never split at the space -- this is
# the "syllable != word" trap CLAUDE.md and the plan's I/O contract table
# both flag: Vietnamese orthography is syllable-segmented, so whitespace is
# never a reliable word boundary on its own.
#
# Hand-picked and linguist-reviewed, not auto-mined; most (47/48) also occur
# verbatim in tests/fixtures/corpus/fixture_corpus.jsonl, so a segmenter's
# golden-file test can check these directly against the fixture corpus, not
# just against this list in isolation. Blank lines and lines starting with
# "#" are comments -- skip them when loading.
#
# Excluded on purpose: classifier + noun pairs (e.g. "con mèo", "bộ phim")
# and other function-word + content-word pairs. Those ARE two separate UD
# tokens (the classifier is its own `clf`-tagged word) -- listing them here
# would contradict Project 2's own classifier-attachment convention.
